title: Vipera: Blending Visual and LLM-Driven Guidance for Systematic Auditing of Text-to-Image Generative AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on an interactive Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) system designed to assist human auditors in exploring and organizing auditing criteria for generative AI. While it aims to surface 'harmful behaviors' and 'social biases' within the framework of Responsible AI, it is primarily a tool-and-system paper rather than a study evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or philosophical frameworks.
